title: Default theme settings
intro: Configure homepage copy, side rails, navigation, and layout. Public pages pick up value changes immediately; updating this custom settings page itself requires a Web Release and admin reload.
recommendedDescription: Built-in defaults work for most communities. Adjust copy and toggles as needed. Restore recommended defaults rewrites recommended values; this theme has no secret fields.

home.notice.zh-CN.description: Shown above the topic list. Leave empty to hide.

home.notice.en-US.label: Homepage notice (English)
home.notice.en-US.description: English notice copy. Leave empty to hide.

home.empty_description.en-US.description: English empty-list description. Leave empty for built-in copy.

home.right_rail.enabled.description: When off, the desktop homepage hides the right rail.

home.right_rail.show_hot.description: Show hot discussions sorted by reply count.

home.right_rail.show_stats.description: Show topic, reply, category, and tag counts.

home.nav.show_compose.description: Show the new-topic button in the left nav.

home.nav.show_counts.label: Category topic counts
home.nav.show_counts.description: Show topic counts next to category names.

layout.show_announcements.label: Show site announcement banner
layout.show_announcements.description: Theme banner component; announcement content is still managed in admin.

footerHint: Public pages read updated values after save. Custom settings page component updates need a Web Release and admin reload.
